instruction:
Mirrored Duplex IFC Shell

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a metric IFC4 one-storey mirrored duplex shell and save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc, and /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 4 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 2 IfcDoor entities, 4 IfcWindow entities, 6 IfcOpeningElement entities, 6 IfcRelVoidsElement relationships, and 6 IfcRelFillsElement relationships.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The single IfcBuildingStorey is named exactly Duplex Level, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and has Elevation 0.00 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
7. The IfcSpace names are exactly A Living, A Bed, B Living, and B Bed, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
8. Each IfcSpace has clear plan dimensions 4.80 m by 2.00 m, in either X/Y orientation, with tolerance +/-0.08 m, and geometry height 2.80 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
9. The slab is named exactly Duplex Slab, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and has plan dimensions 10.40 m by 4.40 m in either X/Y orientation and thickness 0.20 m, each with tolerance +/-0.08 m for plan dimensions and +/-0.05 m for thickness.
10. The 2 doors each have OverallWidth 0.95 m with tolerance +/-0.08 m, and each door fills exactly one IfcOpeningElement that voids an IfcWall.
11. The 4 windows each have OverallWidth 1.20 m with tolerance +/-0.08 m, and each window fills exactly one IfcOpeningElement that voids an IfcWall.
12. Each wall has height 3.00 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m and plan thickness either 0.15 m or 0.20 m with tolerance +/-0.04 m.
13. Exactly 1 full-height party wall has X-axis thickness no greater than 0.30 m, Y-axis length at least 4.00 m, and center X coordinate within +/-0.25 m of the midpoint of the Duplex Slab X-axis bounding-box span.
14. All spaces, walls, the slab, doors, and windows are spatially assigned to Duplex Level.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
